weather.label: Weather
weather.remarks: The weather data comes from Open-Meteo. It is free for clubs and other non-commercial use. If you use it commercially, you need your own licence directly from Open-Meteo.

picker.title: Feature blocks
picker.details_no_menu: This block does not bring any menu entries of its own.
picker.dependents_confirm: {{blocks}} depend on this block and will also be switched off. Continue?
picker.removal_confirm: Saving will remove the menu entries of the following blocks: {{blocks}}. Continue?
picker.drift_note: For these menu entries the value in use today differs from the one the catalogue specifies. Both buttons above apply to every entry in this list: "Adopt catalogue values" writes the catalogue value everywhere. "Keep live values" changes nothing and copies a note you can use to bring the catalogue in line with today's values. Label, icon and order stay untouched either way.
picker.drift_legend_forked: This tenant adjusted the entry earlier and has had its own copy of it ever since. Later catalogue changes no longer reach it on their own — so a difference here is normal and often intended.
picker.drift_legend_edited: The entry is still shared with everyone else but was changed directly in the database. The next «Apply catalogue values» resets it to the catalogue value — if today's value is the right one, choose «Keep live values».
picker.drift_confirm:
For these menu entries today's value is replaced by the catalogue value:

{{entries}}

Label, icon and order are kept. Continue?
picker.drift_skew_warning: Careful: for {{count}} entries the server plans something other than what is shown here ({{entries}}). The app and the server are working from different catalogue versions - the server functions have not been published since the last catalogue change. These entries will not be corrected, or will be corrected differently.
picker.drift_nothing_planned: The server plans no change for any of these {{count}} entries. The app and the server are working from different catalogue versions - the server functions have to be published first. Nothing was written.
picker.menu_impact_readded: These rows are appended at the end of the list: {{keys}}
picker.drift_keep_live_copied: Note copied. Pass it on so the catalogue gets updated — nothing changed here.
picker.preview_extended: Make {{count}} existing menu entries available to this tenant
picker.profile_confirm: "{{profile}}" sets the selection to {{count}} blocks. Nothing is saved yet — you can adjust afterwards and still have to save. Continue?
picker.profile_applied: Selection set to "{{profile}}". Not saved yet.
picker.cancel_confirm: The selection is reset to the saved state. Your changes are lost. Continue?
